_about: Copy to trader/config.json. Every number here is yours to change.
_min_reward_risk_note: 1.5 and not 1.0 on purpose. A 1.0 gross reward-to-risk is about 0.72 after Indian intraday costs on a typical position, so a 1R target is a losing trade before it starts. Run nse-timemachine to see the net number for your own size.
_flat_by_note: 15:15, not the 15:30 close: brokers square off MIS positions themselves at about 15:20 at market.

charges._about: Rates as published by NSE and a discount broker's calculator, read 2026-11-10. They move with exchange and government circulars. Verify against a real contract note before trusting a number to the rupee. Anything left out here falls back to the defaults in charges.py.
